size.value: 4.5cm x 3.5cm (45mm x 35mm) — same dimension pair as DB, order transposed

validity.value: Photo must be recent, less than 6 months old ("récente de moins de 6 mois")

cross_verification.size: Official source (Côte d'Ivoire embassy in France, gouv.ci domain) states '4,5 cm sur 3,5 cm' which is the same dimension pair as DB's '3.5 × 4.5cm' (order transposed, not a real conflict). A separate document category (diplomatic/service passport holders) on the same site lists 50mm x 70mm, but that applies to a different applicant category, not the standard visa photo.
